source.document: Cessna Model 172 Series 1977 thru 1986 Service Manual, D2065-3-13, Revision 3 (1995), incl. Temporary Revisions 4 and 5
source.copyright: Copyright Cessna Aircraft Company. Facts and page references only; no manual images are reproduced.
source.page_convention: 'page' = 1-based PDF page index of the 639-page scan; 'manual_page' = page number printed on the sheet (e.g. '4-2')

meta.applicability: Model 172P = 1981-1986, serials 17274010 thru 17276654 (manual cross-reference listing, PDF page 8). Figures often cover 1977-1986 (172N/172P/172Q/F172); serial effectivity is recorded per figure/item as printed.
meta.routing_order: Each routing list runs in order from the cockpit control (or source) to the surface (or consumer).

control_rigging.summary: Primary cable in aft drum groove wrapped once; chain ends equidistant; secondary turnbuckles synchronize wheels; bar across wheels; direct and carry-thru turnbuckles center bellcrank stop bushings at 40 +/- 10 lb carry-thru tension; push-pull rods set ailerons neutral to flap TE (flaps up); single-wrap safety.

Push-pull rods 8.83 +/- .12 in; actuating tube collar .12 +/- .05 in; setscrew 60 lb-in Loctite CV; up limit switch set at full up; cables 30 +/- 10 lb; down limit at Fig 1-1 travel; follow-up indicator .03 in max clearance, 10 and 20 deg detents.
Lock column with neutral rigging tool (Fig 8-3); streamline elevators; turnbuckles equally to 30 +/- 10 lb; set stop bolts to travel; check control U clears panel and firewall.
Wheel full nose-down; tab up with max 2 deg overtravel; set stop blocks per Fig 9-2; pointer centered in slot; tension 15-20 lb.
Set travel stops; clevises adjusted so pedals neutral at 6.50 in from firewall to pivot shafts (tension automatic via return springs); steering tube rod ends 1.00 in; rig rudder trim per 10-14.
Bungee between rudder bar and bellcrank; lever in center hole of bracket; pushrod ball ends adjusted to align. Linkage: lever (3) -> pushrod (8) -> bellcrank (7) -> trim bungee (5) -> rudder bar (6).
